{
  "$schema": "https://anthropic.com/claude-code/plugin.schema.json",
  "name": "secret-guard",
  "version": "0.1.0",
  "description": "A mod that redacts secret-shaped strings (GitHub, Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, AWS, Slack and Stripe keys, PEM private keys) to [redacted:<kind>] before they are kept in the conversation: in your prompt before it is sent, and in the model's response before it is stored.",
  "author": {
    "name": "Seiya Kawamura"
  },
  "homepage": "https://github.com/insession-space/claude-ship",
  "repository": "https://github.com/insession-space/claude-ship",
  "license": "MIT",
  "keywords": [
    "mod",
    "security",
    "secret",
    "redaction",
    "api-key"
  ],
  "types": "./types/index.d.ts"
}
